limited_pilot.allowed_scope: synthetic or anonymized data; read-only analysis and internal confirmed actions; no live provider mutation and no production promotion
limited_pilot.reason: implementation is substantial, but the exact candidate SHA has no complete PostgreSQL/runtime, live-provider, canary or production evidence
required_next_evidence: isolated canary with rollback and observation

full_tz.reason: nine criteria still have no complete implementation and no criterion has same-SHA canary or production evidence
